resources.string: Uses the same preferences as the Discovery filters. Columns adapt to available space. Changing page size or repeat policy keeps the current materialized page and revises subsequent pages; this does not submit a new keyword search.
Wait for settings to load before editing discovery preferences.
The existing power and source limits still apply. Discovery stays stopped while this settings page is open or the app is in the background.
Restores 2 columns, 20 results per page, Prefer new, and Balanced. Keeps history, provider progress, source configuration, and all other settings.
Settings or tab addresses could not be saved. Changes may revert after restart. Check available storage; this warning does not confirm that a later write succeeded.
Saved settings could not be read. Discovery preference editing is unavailable to protect the saved values. Reopen the app to retry loading.
